description: This line plot compares the metric PPL across different discrete values for three conditions of the parameter γ. The x-axis lacks an explicit label and displays a discrete scale with tick marks at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis is labeled "PPL" and features a linear scale ranging from 7.7 to 8.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three solid lines, all utilizing circular markers. The blue line, representing γ=0.25, starts at 8.19 at 2K, declines sharply to 7.83 at 4K, rises slightly to 7.84 at 8K, drops to 7.78 at 16K, rises to 7.79 at 32K, and ends at 7.78 at 64K. The orange line, representing γ=0.5, begins at 8.20 at 2K, drops sharply to 7.84 at 4K, declines to 7.74 at 8K, remains steady at 7.74 at 16K, drops to 7.73 at 32K, and remains flat to end at 7.73 at 64K. The green line, representing γ=0.75, starts at 8.20 at 2K, drops sharply to 7.84 at 4K, declines to 7.75 at 8K, drops to 7.73 at 16K, decreases to 7.72 at 32K, and remains steady to end at 7.72 at 64K.
